description: Car parks and on-street parking nearest to a coordinate, with free spaces right now for cars or scooters, fare and opening status, nearest first. Coverage differs per city (NewTaipei has on-street parking only). Example: lat 25.0478, lon 121.517, city "Taipei".

city.description: City: a TDX code (Taipei, NewTaipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, Tainan, Kaohsiung, Keelung, Hsinchu, HsinchuCounty, MiaoliCounty, ChanghuaCounty, NantouCounty, YunlinCounty, Chiayi, ChiayiCounty, PingtungCounty, YilanCounty, HualienCounty, TaitungCounty, KinmenCounty, PenghuCounty, LienchiangCounty) or its Chinese name (臺北市, 新北市, 高雄市, ...).

kind.description: Car parks ("offStreet"), curbside segments ("onStreet") or both ("all", default).

limit.description: Maximum number of places to return (default 5).

vehicle.description: Spaces for a "car" (default) or a "scooter" (機車).

want.description: "space": leave out places known to be full or closed (places without live data stay in); "any": every place. Default "space".

name: parking_nearby
title: Nearest parking
